notes: A reproducible, assumption-dependent equal-weight whole-cohort law, not recovery of the inaccessible peso_lab distribution. No target records or target estimates used. All 3000 people are new draws; no seed selection, empirical recentering, weighting, or forced sample moments. BP is marginal over unobserved treatment and disease status; no treatment, hypertension or HbA1c restriction is imposed. Interpretation is association, not intervention. Baseline BP is modeled, not BP at laboratory collection. Released final-reading aggregation is unknown, and source last-two-reading precision is not known to transport. Use the attached provenance when interpreting all three requested analyses.

provenance.limitations: No source identifies the peso_lab-weighted complete-case distribution. Covariate and outcome transports are provisional and do not assert national representativeness. Source age/BMI partial residual correlation is not the raw correlation or full task partial correlation. No HbA1c, hypertension or treatment selection imposed. Baseline pregnancy exclusion/unknown retention and dictionary admissibility are conditioning assumptions, not empirically estimated selection mechanisms. The reported laboratory weight does not make laboratory timing synchronous with baseline interview BP. Unknown final-reading aggregation retained as a limitation. Repeated simulated people provide Monte Carlo precision only, not new empirical evidence.

parameter_provenance.transfer: Population selection is represented by a conditional complete-case law, not simulated raw records or survey weights.

parameter_provenance.rationale: Age beta shapes chosen to supply a broad adult law centered in mid-40s, without pretending that selected E6 ages identify laboratory weights. Sex probability transported from E5 rounded fraction. Lab participation, complete-case selection and pregnancy exclusions are assumed absorbed; their exact effects are unknown.

parameter_provenance.rationale: 0.2 uplift of age-center means compensates approximately for within-source age curvature, not a fitted correction. Age increases then late-life decline reflect adult adiposity patterns. Shifted gamma provides positive skew, finite moments and avoids implausibly negative BMI. Lower shift12 is a modeling support choice, not a released dictionary bound.

Source omitted-covariate effects and treatment-selection change in BMI slope assumed small on net.
